Purpose & context

Kushal (GitHub: kusl) is building MyRestaurant — a self-hosted, single-restaurant ordering system licensed under AGPL-3.0-only. The stack is .NET 10 Blazor Server, PostgreSQL 17 with Dapper only (EF Core explicitly forbidden), DbUp startup migrations, rootless Podman Compose, ASP.NET Core Identity with custom Dapper stores, Argon2id password hashing, WebAuthn passkeys (.NET 10 built-in), TOTP with recovery codes, and OpenTelemetry with OTLP export. The repo is kusl/myrestaurant on GitHub (main branch), developed on Fedora 44, with iPhone SE 2020 (375px) as the primary mobile test target. A secondary host named "virginia" (Debian trixie, Podman/podman-compose, no .NET SDK) is used for dev/testing via Tailscale.

The dependency direction is WebApplication → DataAccess → Domain (Domain is BCL-only). The project follows strict spec-first discipline: behavior, requirements, specs, ADRs, and docs land together in each slice. Milestones M1–M5 are complete; M6 (hardening) is in progress.

Current state

M6 is the active milestone, delivering discrete numbered slices. Recent slices completed:

Slice 21–22: CI engine detection fix (F-43), CounterBoard live attributes (F-44), .dockerignore allow-list (F-45), package-visibility governance gate (F-46), documentation debt closure
Slice 23: data-loaded attribute extended to all seven live interactive surfaces (F-44 follow-up), SpecificationVersionTests automated header/changelog agreement check
Slice 24: Response security headers middleware (F-49) — CSP with WebSocket-aware connect-src, frame-ancestors 'self' (framework-emitted), 46 new assertions
Slice 25: RESTAURANT_SOURCE_URL environment variable wired into the container via compose.yaml (F-50), fixing silent AGPL §13 source-offer failure for forks; 5 new xUnit facts
dev_instance.sh script: New scripts/dev_instance.sh for virginia, supporting up/url/status/logs/down/--help subcommands, detached tunnel container (survives SSH exit), reuses existing tunnel URL to preserve passkeys, HTTP readiness probing with curl/wget/podman exec fallback, fully-qualified image names fix for Debian Podman

Test suite is currently at ~1056 passing tests. Known open item: OPERATIONS.md §2 incorrectly claims .env is auto-created by scripts.

Key learnings & principles

Document policy, never platform state: A document states what the system does; repository settings pages are operator-verified separately (finding F-42 category)
Atomic documentation rule: Every behavior change, requirement edit, spec edit, ADR edit, and ledger row lands in one commit/slice
Defect ledger pattern: DOCUMENTATION_REVIEW.md tracks findings as F-series entries with status, ruling, and embodiment; BUILD_PROGRESS.md tracks slice completion
Fully-qualified image names on Debian Podman: Short names (postgres:17-alpine) fail because unqualified-search registries are disabled; always use docker.io/library/postgres:17-alpine
Tunnel-before-build ordering: Opening a Cloudflare quick tunnel before building the container image makes the URL unreachable for the entire build duration; build first, then open tunnel
Detached tunnel containers: Running the tunnel as a Podman container (not a child process) is required when the session is a remote SSH connection that will close
CSP 'self' and WebSockets: connect-src 'self' does not reliably cover ws: from http: pages; derive ws://{host} wss://{host} from the normalized request host explicitly
Npgsql timestamptz → DateTime: Npgsql materializes timestamptz as UTC DateTime; Dapper constructor binding (positional records) refuses the DateTimeOffset mismatch — use internal row types with DateTime fields and project to DateTimeOffset records
SupplyParameterFromForm initializers: = new() triggers BL0008; use = default! with ??= new() in OnInitialized
Static-SSR intermediate render race: ComponentBase calls StateHasChanged() the moment OnInitializedAsync suspends — null-guard all render-path field accesses
pg_advisory_xact_lock for concurrency-sensitive operations (setup bootstrap, sitting mutations)
Append-only event log (ADR-0002); UUIDv7 surrogate keys (ADR-0011); no Moq (hand-written fakes per §16.1); xUnit v3 with Testcontainers against real Postgres
Gate sensitivity proofs: Every blocking CI gate assertion must be individually proven sensitive before delivery
Proven test counts are arithmetic predictions: Never state E2E scenario counts as observed unless actually run

Approach & patterns

Delivery format (non-negotiable): Every slice is a structured .tar.gz archive named with slice number and feature (e.g., m6-slice-25-*.tar.gz), extracting at the repo root, containing full complete files at exact repo-relative paths — never diffs, never patches, never bespoke text-manipulation scripts. Kushal will miss inline scripts.
Files to delete: Always include an explicit "Files to DELETE" section, even when empty; use git rm for tracked files
git add reminders: Required for any new untracked directory, since gate scripts use git ls-files enumeration
BUILD_PROGRESS.md: Ships as a full complete file in every archive (the docs/_append/ mechanism is retired)
_CHANGES.md: Required in every archive, explaining every decision
Static checks in lieu of compiler: Brace/paren/bracket balance walks (string-and-comment-aware), CS4007 scan (no await in interpolated string holes), CS1620 scan, Razor tag-tree and @code block balance, selector existence checks, bash -n + shellcheck --severity=style for shell scripts, YAML parse validation, byte-level hygiene (no CR, final newline, no whitespace-only lines)
SHA-256 verification: Reconstruct working tree from dump.txt and verify file hashes before editing
Repository reconstruction: Use Python splitter parsing # FILE: and --- CONTENT --- headers to split dump.txt into working tree at /home/claude/repo/; use grep -n "^# FILE: ${q}$" + awk for individual file extraction
GitHub API: curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_PAT" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}?ref={branch}" for framework source verification; PAT must never appear in any response or generated file
Communication style: Terse and directive; resume immediately on "please continue" or "go" without preamble; minimal prose

Tools & resources

Languages/frameworks: .NET 10, Blazor Server, ASP.NET Core Identity, Dapper, Npgsql, DbUp, xUnit v3, Testcontainers, Playwright (E2E), AwesomeAssertions
Infrastructure: Podman/podman-compose (rootless), Cloudflare quick tunnels (scripts/quick_tunnel.sh) and named tunnels for production, Caddy (removed in favor of Cloudflare tunnels), GitHub Actions CI, GHCR for release images
Key scripts: scripts/dev_instance.sh (virginia dev instance), scripts/backup.sh, scripts/restore.sh, scripts/restore_drill.sh, scripts/check_tree.sh (gate 1), scripts/check_repository.sh (gate 6 — tree half blocking, platform half advisory), scripts/ci_local.sh, export.sh
Spec/doc files: docs/TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATION.md (currently v1.10), docs/REQUIREMENTS.md (rev 5), docs/OPERATIONS.md, docs/DOCUMENTATION_REVIEW.md, docs/BUILD_PROGRESS.md, docs/adr/
Reference project: kusl/gotunnels (Go reference for tunnel, passkey, Argon2id, TOTP, OTel patterns)
